title: Require One-Way Service Proof Dependencies
forbids: production imports, re-exports, dynamic imports, or CommonJS resolution into the owning service's test tree
why: Proof consumes production authority. Production never depends on a fixture, harness, or assertion that exists only to prove it.
remediate: Move a reusable value to its qualified production owner or keep it as a fixture beside the contract, semantics, or execution proof that consumes it.
message: Service production source must not import package proof.
